paragraphs: PHA-Web is web-based software that provides tenant, property, and financial management to housing authorities across the United States. The software comes from Management Computer Services, Inc., which was founded in 1968 and by 1970 had dedicated its services to public housing authorities. Company pages put the reach of the software at over 800 agencies nationwide and at over 25 percent of the housing authority industry.

Tenant, property, and financial components are described as the core of the software. Portals for applicants, tenants, and landlords sit alongside those components. A Document Imaging component stores tenant, landlord, and vendor files. An Executive Dashboard presents key performance indicators, metrics, and reports for executive staff.
Feature work described on the site covers use from any mobile device, reduced paper usage, and reporting for executive staff members. The careers page describes the company as a small business.

quote.text: By 1970, we dedicated our services exclusively to Public Housing Authorities.
